styles.name: Stacked Paper - Hari and Deepti Paper Light Boxes

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Cut-paper illustration made from a small hierarchy of flat colored shapes with visible layered depth, in the manner of Hari and Deepti's layered paper light boxes.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use broad paper-color regions chosen from the requested palette. Limit small accents and maintain clear neighboring values.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Use shallow consistent contact shadows between paper layers to reveal overlap. These support shadows do not replace lighting requested within the represented scene.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Keep edges mostly clean with slight hand-cut variation. Show paper thickness sparingly at overlaps, not around every internal detail.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Keep the requested mood; paper construction does not require a cute, childlike or cheerful subject.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Wash illustration with selectively reserved dry marks that interrupt translucent pigment layers, in the manner of Winslow Homer's watercolors with reserved whites.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use transparent washes from the requested palette, retaining light support in chosen areas and allowing a few intentional overlaps.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Describe illumination through wash value and untouched support. Keep the brightest reserved marks consistent with the focal structure.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Let wet pigment pool against selected resist boundaries. Alternate smooth wash passages with sparse dry marks; do not apply the effect uniformly.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Follow the user tone through wash density and mark spacing without requiring a dreamy setting or childish drawing.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Opaque painted illustration organized into broad color planes with selective visible brush edges, in the manner of Milton Avery's flat color planes.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Build a compact palette from the requested colors. Separate light, middle and dark planes clearly without outlining every boundary.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Represent illumination as connected changes of plane and value. Reserve soft transitions for selected turning surfaces.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Use matte paint coverage with occasional dry drag at a few edges. Keep the bulk of each plane calm and opaque.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Retain the requested mood through chroma, value spacing and edge softness instead of substituting a storybook scene.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Shallow relief-print illustration using restrained raised or impressed marks on a continuous support, in the manner of blind-embossed relief prints.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Keep support and impression within the requested palette. Use small tonal differences and optional supplied accent color instead of inventing text or ornament.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Use a consistent grazing light on the image support to reveal shallow depth while preserving the represented scene and its requested content.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show slight compression around selected impressed edges and a smooth matte support. Keep depth small and consistent.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Respect the user mood; subtle relief is a material image-making technique, not a mandatory luxury invitation theme.

styles.name: Toned Ground - Alphonse Mucha Toned Drawings

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Drawing on mid-value colored paper, using the support as a continuous middle tone and placing broad dark and light marks selectively over it, in the manner of drawings on toned paper by Mucha.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Let the paper carry the middle value, using charcoal or a palette-matched dark pigment for shadows and opaque chalk for chosen highlights. Keep the requested color direction recognizable.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Follow the requested illumination: group the dark marks on its shadow side and place chalk only on existing planes that face the light. Do not add a separate spotlight.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Keep the support's even midtone visible between marks. Use broad rubbed charcoal and small opaque chalk accents without simulating an engraved plate or a black plate ground.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Carry the requested mood through the balance of open paper, dark mass and light accents; the drawing method does not imply a studio, memorial or historical scene.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Dry-pastel illustration built by layering soft pigment across a toothed paper surface, with the exposed tooth breaking broad color passages into small coherent flecks, in the manner of Odilon Redon's pastels.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Respect the requested palette. Build a compact value range from adjacent pastel layers, leaving some support visible between marks and reserving the strongest chroma for existing focal forms.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Preserve the requested light direction. Deepen existing shadow groups with denser dry pigment and soften selected transitions without spreading a glow beyond the forms.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Let the paper tooth interrupt the pigment visibly. Feather only chosen joins by rubbing; keep separate marks in the rest of each passage instead of creating a uniformly blended airbrush.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Carry the requested mood through pigment density, softness and spacing. Dry pastel does not require a nostalgic scene, a theatrical backdrop or a particular subject.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Layered pigment illustration in which a few deliberate incisions through a dry upper color reveal a contrasting underlayer carried by the same image, in the manner of Italian sgraffito facades.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use colors from the requested palette for both layers, keeping their value difference large enough for the revealed ground to read as a purposeful part of the depicted form.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Follow the requested illumination. Keep the exposed underlayer within existing lit or shadowed regions; incisions are marks in the pigment, not a new light source.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show narrow, crisp channels where the upper pigment has been scraped aside, with limited roughness at their ends. Keep the lower layer flat and continuous rather than building a raised ridge.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Retain the requested mood through the amount and spacing of exposed marks. Scraping pigment does not require a distressed, antique or archaeological subject.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Watercolor illustration whose value passages form through mineral pigment settling into the paper tooth, leaving naturally separated grains within otherwise transparent washes, in the manner of granulating watercolor landscapes.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Follow the requested palette with transparent pigments. Build value through the concentration and spacing of settled granules, keeping paper lights open and avoiding opaque muddy mixtures.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Respect the requested light direction. Concentrate pigment on existing shadow planes and let exposed support carry the brightest values; do not imply a new light source.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show particles collecting in the paper's shallow valleys and loosening across damp passages. Create this grain by pigment behavior rather than resist marks, stamped dots or a texture overlay.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Retain the requested mood through wash openness and grain density; mineral granulation does not prescribe a dreamy landscape or any other setting.

styles.name: Optical Glaze - Jan van Eyck Glazes

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Transparent-pigment illustration built by laying thin color films over fully dried passages, so each layer shifts the underlying hue without obscuring its structure, in the manner of Jan van Eyck's optical glazes.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Respect the requested palette and apply transparent layers sequentially, allowing their overlap to enrich selected colors. Keep each underlying value plane visible through the glazing.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Follow the requested illumination and keep its shadow pattern stable between layers. Build depth with transparent color shifts, not added dark outlines or a new glow.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show smooth, distinct dried layers with clean overlaps and only slight brush-edge variation. Keep pigment in place after drying instead of creating a wet bloom or resist boundary.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Carry the requested mood through layered chroma and value depth. Transparent glazing does not require jewel tones, decorative ornament or an ethereal scene.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Opaque-paint illustration on prepared paper, formed with loaded palette-knife deposits whose raised ridges turn across depicted shapes and leave neighboring areas broadly calm, in the manner of Nicolas de Stael's knife impasto.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Respect the requested palette. Mix opaque colors in compact groups and place the strongest light and dark deposits within the existing value structure, not as decorative accents.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Follow the requested lighting. Let the paint ridges catch restrained highlights in that same direction while keeping their relief subordinate to the depicted form.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show discrete knife-set ridges, occasional scraped gaps and broad flat passages. The texture is thick pigment on prepared paper, not an embossed support, fabric weave or universal crust.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Retain the requested mood through paint density and edge rhythm. Impasto does not require a dramatic studio, landscape, still life or any other prescribed scene.

styles.name: Inclusion Paper Ground - Japanese Unryu Paper

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Inclusion paper ground in the manner of Japanese unryu paper with fiber inclusions: light painting on thick handmade paper full of pressed petals, grass fibers and seeds, with deckled edges framing the image.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Soft washes of color over an off-white sheet flecked with pink, green and gold inclusions.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Gentle diffuse light, with raking side light revealing the uneven fibrous paper surface.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Pressed petals, stray fibers, seed flecks, lumpy handmade surface and soft torn deckle edges.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Gentle, botanical and handmade, like a keepsake from a garden.

styles.name: Translucent Tissue Layers - Eric Carle Tissue

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Translucent tissue layers in the manner of Eric Carle's painted tissue: torn and cut tissue paper glued in overlapping sheets, colors multiplying where they cross and wrinkles catching the light.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Bright translucent tissue colors such as magenta, lemon and cyan mixing into new tones where they overlap.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Light seems to pass through the layers, with darker zones where many sheets stack.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Glue wrinkles, soft torn edges, visible overlaps, faint glue sheen and slight bleeding of dye.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Cheerful, luminous and handmade, like a sunlit window collage.

styles.name: Singed Paper Burn-Through - Paper Burn Art

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Singed paper burn-through in the manner of burned paper artworks: an image made by scorching and burning paper, with browned gradients, charred edges and holes burned clean through.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Cream paper browning through amber and umber to black char at the burned edges.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Tone comes from scorch depth; holes let light or a dark backing show through.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Curled charred edges, delicate ash rims, heat-browned halos and crisp burned holes.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Dramatic, fragile and dangerous, an image made by fire.

styles.name: Poured Pulp Painting - Papermaking Pulp Painting

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Poured pulp painting in the manner of pulp paintings pulled at the paper vat: an image made by pouring and placing wet colored paper pulp into a sheet, so shapes have soft fibrous edges and the color is inside the paper.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Earthy and bright pulp colors such as indigo, terracotta and moss, matte and fully saturated in the fiber.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft even light over a matte surface, with subtle relief where pulp was layered thicker.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Fibrous feathered edges, lumpy pulp thickness, deckled borders and matte felted surface.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Earthy, calm and tactile, color grown into the paper itself.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Bleach-drawn colored paper in the manner of bleach drawings on colored paper: lines and shapes drawn with bleach on dark dyed paper, lifting the dye into unexpected pale oranges, pinks and creams.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Deep navy, black or purple paper with bleached marks turning rust orange, pink or pale cream.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Light areas are lifted with more bleach; darks stay the original paper dye.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Soft bleach bleed edges, brush and nib marks, uneven lifting and slight paper cockling.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Mysterious, glowing and unexpected, light pulled from darkness.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Folded tessellation relief in the manner of Eric Gjerde's origami tessellations: a single sheet pleated and folded into a repeating geometric relief, with the subject emerging from light and shadow on the folds.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: White or single-color paper, with value created entirely by light and shadow on the folds.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Strong raking light across the pleats, bright faces and deep shadowed valleys forming the image.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Crisp folds, repeating pleat modules, slightly softened crease lines and paper grain.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Precise, sculptural and meditative, geometry made from one sheet.

styles.name: Pinpricked Paper Light - Victorian Pinprick Pictures

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Pinpricked paper light in the manner of Victorian pinprick pictures: a picture made by piercing thousands of tiny holes through paper, seen glowing when held against light or as raised dots in side light.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Cream or dark paper with glowing warm points of light where it is pierced.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Backlight shining through the holes, or raking light catching raised burrs around them.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Tiny round holes of varied size, raised paper burrs and slightly yellowed old paper.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Delicate, magical and old-fashioned, like a candlelit keepsake.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Dusted pigment stencil in the manner of French pochoir stencil prints: loose powdered pigment dusted through stencils onto paper, leaving soft velvety color fields with feathered edges and loose grains.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Rich raw pigments such as ultramarine, cadmium red and yellow ochre, intensely saturated and matte.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: No modeled light; density of dusted powder creates lighter and darker areas.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Velvety powder, stray grains, soft feathered stencil edges and faint fingerprints in the dust.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Vivid, soft and fragile, color that could blow away.

styles.name: Vellum Overlay Layers - Anatomy Book Overlays

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Vellum overlay layers in the manner of layered anatomy book overlays: drawings on several translucent drafting sheets stacked on top of each other, earlier layers softening behind later ones.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Graphite and ink lines with a few color accents, back layers dimmed by milky translucency.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Soft diffuse light through the sheets, each layer adding a veil of haze.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Frosted translucent sheets, visible sheet edges, tape corners and slight curling.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Thoughtful, layered and dreamy, like design ideas piling up.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Synthetic-sheet watercolor swirl in the manner of watercolor swirled on synthetic paper: watercolor on smooth non-absorbent plastic paper, where pigment floats, swirls and dries in sharp-edged pools and lifted trails.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Intense saturated watercolor that stays bright on the white sheet, mixing in marbled swirls.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Lights wiped back to pure white; darks where pigment pooled and dried thick.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Hard drying rings, marbled swirls, wiped trails and a slightly glossy smooth surface.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Vibrant, liquid and surprising, color with a mind of its own.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Gouache-resist drawing: dry water-soluble gouache protects broad light shapes before an India-ink coat is washed back. The finished image has substantial black ink masses around pale color islands, irregular eaten-back boundaries and a few stubborn ink flecks within the exposed areas.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use the requested hues as restrained stains in the exposed paper, with deeper black ink between them. Allow the color to vary gently within an island; keep enough unbroken pale area for the black-to-light contrast to read.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Follow the requested direction of light. Join existing shadow planes into ink masses and reveal illuminated planes by washing back the protective layer, preserving a few soft stained transitions rather than drawing every boundary as a line.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show porous ink residue, tiny uneven black remnants and ragged wash-off edges where the resist dissolves. Keep the centers of larger light shapes relatively clear. Ink remnants cluster along boundaries and in occasional thinly protected patches, without regular wood grain or parallel carved hatching.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Support the requested emotion through the weight of the dark masses and the openness of the pale shapes. The treatment can carry menace, absurdity or stillness without prescribing a story or historical setting.

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Layered mineral-pigment painting with broad, closely fitted color planes. Fine and coarse crushed-pigment grades produce different depths of color and a restrained granular surface; individual grains catch small points of light within otherwise matte paint.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Keep the requested color relationships. Use deep, densely packed color beside paler fine-grain passages of the same hue, making transitions through layered pigment rather than glossy airbrush gradients. Reserve quieter pale planes for focal clarity.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Honor the requested illumination in simplified value groups. Small particle glints belong to the painted surface and must not become new lights, luminous auras or metallic reflections on the depicted subject.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show closely packed mineral grains embedded in thin paint layers: coarser and darker in selected broad passages, finer and softer near delicate details. Keep the support faint and the boundaries clean; avoid the transparent tide marks of watercolor granulation.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Carry the requested tone through dense color, still areas and controlled surface sparkle. Do not prescribe sacred calm, a mythic narrative or a particular culture to the subject.

styles.name: Scraped Color Tracks - Crayon Scratch Art

dna.label: Look
dna.text: Crayon scratch art: a dense black wax coat lies over a rubbed field of colored crayon. Drawing removes the black coat in blunt grooves, short rakes and broader scraped patches, exposing the colored wax underneath. Color is revealed by subtraction rather than drawn as a glowing line on top.

dna.label: Color
dna.text: Use a few hues from the requested palette in the wax underlayer. Neighboring scratches can reveal the same color band across different objects because that color was laid down before the drawing. Use intact black wax for the deepest values, dense exposed color for lighter planes and sparse colored scratches for intermediate values.

dna.label: Light
dna.text: Translate the requested light into the amount of colored wax exposed. Scraped tracks have their own pigment color, without emitting light or producing a halo. Preserve the scene light direction while keeping shadows as substantial black areas of untouched coating.

dna.label: Texture
dna.text: Show the drag of a blunt stylus through soft wax: uneven groove width, blunt starts, small black crumbs caught in some tracks and occasional waxy streaks in the revealed color. Broad scraped planes retain traces of black coating. Keep these marks tied to the drawing rather than scattered over the whole image.

dna.label: Mood
dna.text: Carry the requested mood through the pressure, pace and spacing of the scraped marks. The medium supports tension, humor or stillness without forcing a nursery scene, rainbow ornament, nocturnal setting or smiling character.
